mapper.sql: id, event_key as eventKey, recipient, msg_type as msgType, content, extra_json as extraJson, request_hash as requestHash, status, message_id as messageId
mapper.insert: insert ignore into im_notification_intent (event_key, recipient, msg_type, content, extra_json, request_hash, status, create_time) values (#{eventKey}, #{recipient}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{extraJson}, #{requestHash}, 'PENDING', now())
mapper.select: select from im_notification_intent where event_key = #{eventKey} for update
select from im_notification_intent where id = #{id} for update
select max(id) from im_notification_intent where status = 'PENDING'
select id from im_notification_intent where status = 'PENDING' and id > #{afterId} and id <= #{maxId} order by id limit 100
mapper.update: update im_notification_intent set status = 'DELIVERED', message_id = #{messageId}, delivered_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
